notes.title: Patch #7 for Future Fragments IS NOW LIVE!
notes.notes:
PATCH #7 IS NOW LIVE!

-------------------------------

This patch has a small handful of gameplay quality of life improvements and bugfixes, as well as a significant assortment of new sound effects added.

However, there's a LOT more we've got done behind the scenes that'll be in the next patch, but we didn't want to put it in until it was 100% complete.

And speaking of that next patch, we're happy to announce that the next patch will have all remaining story segments left without voicework or finalized script finished off!

This "core content complete patch" will release during September 2025 if all goes well.

After that patch is out, we'll be focusing on free DLC for the game, including, but not limited to:

 The level editor
 Speedrun mode
 More NPCs
 "Challenge" map packs

And of course any bugfixes needed.

We're also doing a 1 week sale for this patch for 20% off, as a celebration for having locked in a date for the "all core content in" patch, starting the minute this post goes up!

-------------------------------


CUTSCENE FIXES / ADDITIONS:


 Added a pink "!" over Faye's head for the [spoiler]P6M2 double machine scene trigger in the Gratification Factory[/spoiler]
 Added more flag settings to [spoiler]Jon Struger's scene in P3M2, Faye's scene in P2M2, and Spartacus's scene in P1M5, all in the Celodst Resupply[/spoiler]
 Removed a line from a cutscene variant in the Volcanic Mines Hub Room scene when you return to the room that was giving conflicting info about your objectives
 Removed the RNG required to trigger a specific Faux Ending
 Edited a rare variant with a Faye conversation to remove plot hole regarding what [spoiler]Vie should know about Talia/Faye[/spoiler]
 Fixed a variant of [spoiler]Mackster's scene in P3M5 of the Volcanic Mines to play the correct voice lines for two lines[/spoiler]
 Fixed a bug that occurred when triggering a specific Faux Ending
 Fixed a sound effect not playing during the [spoiler]Expander CG scene in the Uncharted Wildwoods[/spoiler]
 Fixed a variant of the [spoiler]ADMN Spawner's defeat scene in the Volcanic Mines that had a missing parenthesis[/spoiler]
 Fixed missing audio during [spoiler]Lux Lynns' scene in P3M6 of the Uncharted Wildwoods[/spoiler]
 Fixed an incorrect line during the "return to Save Pad" scenes in the Hub for the [spoiler]Uncharted Wildwoods[/spoiler]
 Fixed two line errors in [spoiler]Voitiry Cuillei's scene in Room 3 (Shifted Brane) in The End[/spoiler]


OTHER CHANGES / FIXES / ADDITIONS:


 Added over 200 sound effects throughout the game
 Added alternate health orb sprites for the [spoiler]Uncharted Wildwoods and The End[/spoiler]
 Disabled self-stunning in multiple locations to prevent players from respawning in unintended places
 Disabled the auto-jumping [spoiler]cybermine effect during the Vie fight in the Uncharted Wildwoods as a temporary solution to an existing bug[/spoiler]
 Changed the layout for the [spoiler]Miasma Containment Area (Fragment Room) in the Celodst Resupply, to prevent a rare possibility of the player overshooting the Fragment if they used a Magma Dash at the absolute boundary of the cutscene trigger, which would softlock the game[/spoiler]
 Fixed issues with numerous existing SFX
 Fixed icons on the megamap showing in unexplored rooms when in a transition module
 Fixed the [spoiler]portal not being visible on Room 42 of The End[/spoiler]
 Fixed the current objective not showing while travelling between Nodes
 Fixed the gallery music not working correctly
 Fixed volume issues when setting options on the title screen
 Fixed [spoiler]WREN saying his fight dialogue while in the Laboratory[/spoiler]
 Fixed a rare issue with the [spoiler]Gratification Factory Hub where you could spawn upside down on the Save Pad after completing a Path[/spoiler]
 Fixed landing on top of the [spoiler]end-path roots of P1M4 of the Uncharted Wildwoods if you jumped as far as possible before activating the scene[/spoiler]
 Fixed visual inconsistencies in [spoiler]P4M3 and P1M5 of the Volcanic Mines[/spoiler]
 Fixed Talia being able to spawn in an unintended place in the [spoiler]Gratification Factory's first QA Room if you used a Magma Dash while entering it[/spoiler]


-------------------------------


That's all for now, until the September 2025 patch; we're looking forward to having all core content complete for you all!

And once you've tried the patch out, we'd like your feedback on it in a review if you get the chance!

notes.title: Update on next patch + 10% off Sale right now
notes.notes:
First, to get it out of the way, we've got a 10% off sale for the next week!

=======================

Now as far as the next patch goes, we're reaching the end-game of getting all core content in.

So, to not spend time on "packaging things together" for playable builds and instead push forward to get things done ASAP, we're not doing a new patch this month.

=======================

As a result, the next patch we release will be the one that should have all core content in it; at the very worst, it'll be missing only a few things.

Shooting for around the end of Summer 2025 for all of that, but once all core content is in, we'll have a big update and notifications about it on all social media.

=======================

Once all core content's in, then we'll finish off the level editor, speedrun mode, SFW mode, bonus free DLC maps/content/cutscenes and so on, while starting up work on our next game.

(We'll still of course continue to do bugfixes and quality of life additions for Future Fragments for a long time, too.)

=======================

Thanks for the patience and understanding as we finish things off; it really does mean the world to us, and we want to give you all the best game we can.

The notes themselves go into a bit more detail than usual, so we'll just let those speak for themselves about all the new additions/fixes.

We're also doing a 1 week sale for this patch, as sort of a post-Easter sale, for 10% off, starting May 1st at 1AM PST!

Added a button prompt to trigger an instant upwards boost when Talia is hovering at the top of an air stream from an air vent in the Volcanic Mines

Added a special "leeway" mechanic to [spoiler]Talia's freeze shot ability, where it should now be significantly easier to hit and freeze fast-moving targets, such as the projectiles fired by the cannons in the Gratification Factory[/spoiler]

Added missing vibration SFX for the relevant [spoiler]Gratification Factory enemies in the gallery (so the gallery matches the in-game SFX for those enemies)[/spoiler]

Added new animations for the [spoiler]Celodst Resupply Laser Puzzle target rings, to make them easier to spot and to differentiate if they are lit up or not[/spoiler]
Added "off" variants for the [spoiler]Uncharted Wildwoods databanks, so you can tell if you've collected them already like in other levels[/spoiler]

notes.title: Patch #5 for Future Fragments IS NOW LIVE!
notes.notes:
PATCH #5 IS NOW LIVE!

-------------------------------

This patch has a huge number of bugfixes, but most notably, it also has some significant gameplay changes and additions:

Finally, the full Gallery is in the game! It'll be retroactively unlocked for those who've already done so, but if you haven't, you'll need 5 Achievements per level, out of 10. However, if you get all 10 achievements in a level, (for the first four levels only), you'll also get a special POV animation not seen anywhere else in the game (it's not some huge thing, just to temper your expectations).

And there's more than H-scenes in the gallery, too; there's also a list of the True Endings (which you can re-watch) and the Faux Endings (you'll be able to re-watch those next patch).

There's also Vie's Hideout, a bonus mode within the Gallery that'll unlock once you've gotten at least one True Ending, where all the H-animations in the game will randomly cycle, aided by Vie's commentary about what's going on (you can toggle this on/off).

A new functionality addition is the Auto-Charge Shot option, so for those of you who don't like holding the button down to fire off Charge Shots, you can now enable this in the options menu, after the first level, to have Talia's Charge Shot constantly charging.

Speaking of making things a bit easier, there's been a few "hint" cutscenes added to areas that some of you have said you have trouble with (they'll play after you've been there a bit), as well as a series of cutscenes/functionality that will allow you to auto-solve the Laser Puzzle rooms if you're totally stuck on them, or just don't like doing those sorts of puzzles.

And to make navigation easier, you can now see the Module you're in, under the minimap.

Finally, we've also made two of the in-game achievements easier, since those were notoriously hard for people to find, and not in a fun way.

-------------------------------

HOW TO REFRESH/UPDATE TO THE NEW PATCH:

In the steam client, right click on the game in your library list, select properties from the dropdown list, then in the Local files tab select Verify integrity of game cache.

notes.title: Update on lowering the difficulty for the "Final Boss"
notes.notes:
So, after many, many people have expressed frustration with him, and after a lot of deliberation, we've decided the following changes will be made to the "final boss" (not the true final boss) of Future Fragments in the next patch.

Hopefully, these changes will make things more accessible to the majority of players/not as frustrating.


[spoiler]The fight will be lowered to 1 cycle of 2 phases, instead of 2 cycles of 2 phases (as people hated getting through one cycle and then losing and having to start from the beginning)[/spoiler]
[spoiler]His health, attack damage, movement speed, and shield health will be lowered by 10%[/spoiler]
[spoiler]The speed at which his shield cycles will be reduced by 50% (as this was one of the biggest pain points, having to switch skills super fast)[/spoiler]
[spoiler]If you're still having trouble with him, there will be a cutscene that will appear after 10 losses where you'll have the OPTION of making him even easier[/spoiler]
[spoiler]For those who want a challenge, we will be retaining the original fight to be able to access in-game in a later patch through some sort of method[/spoiler]


We realize that some of you really enjoyed the challenge the boss brings, but the amount of people who've reported being frustrated with it is just really, really high.

If this ends up being TOO drastic of a change, we'll try to find a middle ground where he's still weaker than he is now, but not AS much.

In general, we want Future Fragments to be fun and present a challenge, but we're also aware what type of game it is, so we want it to be accessible to most players too.

For those that want a challenge in general too, once everything is done with the game, I'll be making free DLC map packs of extremely hard maps/challenges, so we're not going to neglect those who want really brutal difficulties!

notes.title: Patch Notes #1 for Future Fragments IS NOW LIVE!
notes.notes:
THE PATCH IS NOW LIVE!

Alright, so here's the first patch for the game, almost entirely centered on bugfixes and additional quality of life features!

We have a good number of cutscenes to add to the next patch which we plan to get done very soon, but we didn't want to add a ton of them alongside all the bugfixes and new features and end up breaking things and making it even harder to diagnose what went wrong.

This patch DOES have some new cutscenes though, including the one a lot of people have been waiting for; the one between the Ice Level and Electric Level that explains why [spoiler]Vie has the personality change they do.[/spoiler]

Also, the patch is too big to put in a single post, so I'm gonna have to do it in two!

-------------------------------

HOW TO REFRESH/UPDATE TO THE NEW PATCH:

In the steam client, right click on the game in your library list, select properties from the dropdown list, then in the Local files tab select Verify integrity of game cache.

If everything verifies correctly then you should have the latest patched release on the Steam servers.

-------------------------------

Core Functionality:

 Added small grace period where you are unable to shoot directly after finishing a cutscene (to prevent accidentally shooting the friendly NPC you just talked with)
 Added quality of life feature where holding down X will let you skip past dialogue super quickly (so you don't have to mash X if you get stuck in a cutscene you just want to skip)
 Made the game window freely resizable
 Changed built-in screenshot functionality key to F11 for Steam build to avoid conflicting with Steam's screenshot function on F12


Save Slots:

 Fixed bug where starting a new game would immediately overwrite the AUTO-SAVE slot
 Fixed bug where Save Slot #9 specifically would not load correctly
 Temporarily disabled Save Slot screenshot thumbnails due to them potentially causing issues on some systems when saving (reports of game freezing after saving)
 Potentially Fixed bug where manually saving on the savepad would disable the "back"/"jump" button when playing with a controller

notes.title: IMPORTANT INFO ABOUT THE RELEASE
notes.notes:
So, there's 24 hours left before release at this point, a bit less than that, actually.
Crazy to think we're finally here, huh?

Before launch though, we'd like to go over a few things so everyone is on the same page regarding the game.

REGARDING POST-RELEASE CONTENT
After the game releases, we plan to continue fixing any reported bugs for the game, as well as adding free, new content like;

 additional cutscenes
 additional secret events
 SFW mode
 the Level Editor
 speedrun mode
 more quality of life features and functionality
 more audio (sound effects, extra music, extra voicework for specific h-animations)
 we'll also be taking feedback on improving things regarding game feel/flow, game balance, and so on.
REGARDING THE STATE OF CURRENT IN-GAME CONTENT
Currently, when we launch, there will be a small amount of cutscenes that we didn't have time to get into the game as fully as we wanted, whether that's missing storyline branches/variants, voicework, or similar things.

Over the next month, we plan to frequently update the game, sometimes on a daily basis, to get these particular things up to the level of quality and polish we want them to be. We'll of course continue to improve the game after that, as well.

- As such, you could consider the first month of release a "soft launch" of sorts - there will be rough edges, for sure, but we plan to fix them ASAP. - 

REGARDING GAME KEYS
For those of you who backed the game during development, if you've filled out the questionnaire we sent to backers that reached the key threshold of $20 (same price as Steam), you'll definitely get a key before the game releases, sent to your email inbox.

If any of you have any questions, please feel free to ask here or on Discord...
...but I'll say I might not be able to answer fast since I'm grinding out content nonstop until and through release!

notes.title: Regarding the Release Date change + Regional Prices
notes.notes:
Per the Discord poll we ran yesterday (as well as notifying people about it on Twitter), due to over 80%+ of people voting as such, we've decided to make the following changes.

Effective immediately, the release date for the game is set as "When It's Ready", or "Coming Soon" on Steam.

Currently, for context, the game is about 95% done. We don't think it'll take more than a few months to get everything in that we wanted to be in at launch, but that's just an estimation, not a guarantee of release date.

The next time we give a release date, will be once Steam has approved the game, and it's ready to go.

Also, progress reports will now be bi-weekly; they'll revert to weekly on release.

Hopefully, this fixes a lot of the "rollercoaster effect" disappointment with delays, and we do hope you all understand; we just want the game to have all the core content done before release, because all of you giving us your hard earned money deserve nothing less.
